items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: Yes sir. He wrote, Sorry I Made You Cry.

ctx.x: I gave him a stick, he led the band, he was beating it all around.
We didn't pay any attention to him. You know? He liked the leading bands. Did you know N.J. Classy? Yes sir. He wrote, Sorry I Made You Cry. I'm sorry dear.
Oh, it's up. It was a big hit.
